mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 persons over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth demand regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%.
